remarks: Discover the epitome of charm in this delightful expanded Cape Cod-style home, perfectly situated on the most coveted private lane in all of New Canaan. Walk to the Village, Nature Center and The Roger Sherman Inn in minutes from this captivating jewel at 2 Hampton Lane. Boasting expansive living spaces both inside and out, this lovely home has four generous bedrooms, one suite on the first floor, and three and a half beautifully appointed baths. Enjoy touring the extensive flowering gardens or relax on your private gravel terrace offering a serene escape in your own backyard. This residence is designed to accommodate all of your lifestyle needs effortlessly in the most convenient location. Make this enchanting home your own...
